entities.summary: Rosanna Diane Davison is an Irish actress, singer, writer, model and beauty queen who was crowned Miss World 2003. She is the daughter of musician Chris de Burgh, and the song "For Rosanna" was written by her father for his eighth studio album, Into the Light (1986) in her honour. Davison is a qualified nutritional therapist and promotes the health benefits of a plant-based diet.
